actions.title: Get the exact Hinds land and infrastructure evidence
actions.question: Please confirm current price and seller authority, send the survey/legal description of the offered 110 acres and all easements, and provide the utility/carrier documents underlying the reported deliverable power and fiber. Which legal entity can bind each commitment, and can the rights transfer to an assignee?
actions.decision: Reconcile offered land and turn founder-supplied assertions into auditable evidence.
actions.costEstimate: $0 document request; no study, option or application fee authorized

actions.title: Pin down the 25 MW / 50 MW utility and fiber path
actions.contact: Issuer named in seller/founder utility and carrier evidence
actions.channel: Exact issuer/contact to be identified from documents
actions.question: Do you serve parent CAD 100771 and the attached 110-acre offered survey? For a 25 MW facility, with a possible 50 MW expansion, specify POI/grid, study sequence, dates, upgrades, costs, deposits/security, curtailment/tariff and assignability. Carrier replies must identify two physical routes, capacity, construction lead time and transfer terms.
actions.decision: Establish a studyable path that a funded buyer could sponsor; unknown MW stays null.
actions.costEstimate: $0 process inquiry; any paid next step requires a separate capital decision

actions.title: Resolve the design-specific Texas permit path
actions.contact: TCEQ and Wilbarger County permitting / floodplain referral
actions.channel: Use official agency channels named in the October 3 addendum
actions.question: For the exact offered land and a low-water 25 MW concept with specified backup generation, which air, water, stormwater or wastewater approvals are required and presently paused? What written milestone permits studies or applications to proceed? Confirm local jurisdiction and load-rule applicability.
actions.decision: Do not treat an agency reporting deadline as a permit reopening, or ERCOT rules as automatically applicable.

actions.title: Keep control terms conditional on the evidence
actions.contact: Seller representative and founder's transaction counsel
actions.channel: Prepared discussion only; no agreement sent
actions.question: Would the seller consider expressly assignable control, enforceable extensions, access/authorization for studies and pre-agreed seller financing, with a precise offered legal description? Identify all nonrefundable costs and transfer restrictions before counsel drafts terms.
actions.decision: A proposal is not seller acceptance. No buyer, assignment premium or closing finance is assumed.
actions.costEstimate: $0 negotiation preparation; $5,000 learning and $10,000 all-in soft-control caps unchanged

actions.title: Compare Dillon 53 and 48 before choosing a backup
actions.question: Send offered surveys, seller authority and legal access for APNs 080-00-00-053 and 080-00-00-048, reconcile 48 acreage, identify exact utility contacts and any dated load studies, and share the written RU data-center use path. Would the seller permit assignable, extendable control subject to feasibility?
actions.decision: Advance whichever has the better contiguous pad and credible service path; do not pay for both.
